title: Cull from the keyboard with undo and Auto Advance
notes: #724's keys only; its zoom and photo size go to loupe-viewport. The grid's reject mark (dimmed cell, xmark badge) is drawn by thumbnails, which owns the cell builder; cull changes only Model state. Owns MetadataInspector.swift in wave 2: it routes the stars, flag and label through cull(_:) and gives every control an identifier (most of #291's list); metadata-more takes the file in wave 5. Its (L) steps wait for import to merge. Its PR that lands the loupe keys says 'Part of #724'; whichever of cull and loupe-viewport merges its #724 part last says 'Closes #724'.
